tagline.en: AdaWorld — a latent-action world model that learns actions across domains for action-conditioned video generation.
tagline.zh: AdaWorld——一个潜在动作世界模型，跨域学习动作，用于动作条件视频生成。

en: AdaWorld is a world model built around latent actions: instead of assuming a fixed action space, it learns action representations that transfer across domains, then uses them to generate action-conditioned video. It's an open-source, multi-domain approach to learning how worlds respond to actions.
In WorldFoundry the AdaWorld source is vendored in-tree under the world-model synthesis package, covering latent-action world modeling, action-conditioned video, and multi-domain world-model tasks.
It is provided as source-oriented reference: running it end to end depends on the official dependencies and task/demo assets, and on local checkpoints, being available in your environment.
zh: AdaWorld 是一个围绕潜在动作构建的世界模型：它不假设固定的动作空间，而是学习可跨域迁移的动作表征，再用它们生成动作条件视频。这是一种开源、多域的方法，用于学习世界如何响应动作。
在 WorldFoundry 中，AdaWorld 的源码以内置形式置于世界模型合成包下，涵盖潜在动作世界建模、动作条件视频与多域世界模型任务。
它以面向源码的参考形式提供：端到端运行取决于你的环境中是否具备官方依赖、任务/演示资产以及本地 checkpoint。

whenToUse.en: Use AdaWorld when you're exploring latent-action world models — learning transferable action representations and generating action-conditioned video across multiple domains.
whenToUse.zh: 当你在探索潜在动作世界模型——学习可迁移的动作表征、跨多个域生成动作条件视频时，可以使用 AdaWorld。

notFor.en: It's a source-oriented research model rather than a turnkey generator; running it end to end depends on the official dependencies, assets, and local checkpoints being in place.
notFor.zh: 它是面向源码的研究模型，而非开箱即用的生成器；端到端运行取决于官方依赖、资产与本地 checkpoint 是否就位。

en: Latent-action world model with transferable action representations
Research-oriented: depends on official dependencies and local assets
zh: 带可迁移动作表征的潜在动作世界模型
多域、动作条件的视频生成
开源源码以内置形式提供
偏研究用途：依赖官方依赖与本地资产
